title: Equity ratio and ROA inside countries
statement: Within a country, companies with a higher equity ratio earn higher ROA.
effect_unit: pp ROA per +0.1 equity ratio, within country
notes: Pooled across 28 countries: +1.16 pp (per +0.1 equity ratio; 95% CI +0.96 to +1.36), random-effects p = 0.0000.
Repeats: same sign in 96% of countries (22 significantly, 0 significantly opposite); leave-one-country-out agreement 96%; between-country spread tau = 0.38 pp, I2 = 58%.
Robustness: pooled sign unchanged in 100% of 7 samples.
